Name: Leviathan in a Bottle
Effect Description: Spawn the WoL leviathan but with its spawn mutalisk and spawn brood lord abilities on a 60 second cooldown

Name: Hyperion in a Bottle
Effect Description: Spawn the WoL hyperion with its legendary resistance removed

Name: Drop Pod Wave
Effect Description: Call down 10 terran drop pods on target area.
Development notes: player cannot control them, similar to warfield drop pods. Call down the 10 dropdowns rapidly over the course of 2 seconds. Make it a somewhat wide area.

Name: Mass EMP
Effect Description: Reduce all shields and energy of all units to 0 and remove all cloaked for 30 seconds
Development notes: Sets current energy and shield, not maximum. Does not affect spear of adun but affects both friendly and hostile units.

Name: Tactical Nuke
Effect Description: Immediately detonate a single tactical nuke at target location

Name: Tosh's Miners
Effect Description: Drop down a flying command center with 5 scvs loaded inside of it at target location

Name: Stealth Protocol
Effect Description: All of your units and structures become stealthed for 1 minute

Name: Mass Stimpack
Effect Description: All of your units gain 50% movement and attack speed for 1 minute, but they all lose 1 hp per second during this time.

Name: Mass Marines
Effect Description: Instantly lose up to 5000 minerals. For every 10 minerals lost, spawn a marine at your base that automatically attacks the enemy.
Development notes: spawn the marines over the course of 2 seconds to not lag out the game. Player cannot control the marines. Marines use our standard AI to find an enemy to attack towards while using abilities when relevant.

Name: Mass Spellcasters
Effect Description: Instantly lose up to 5000 gas. For every 20 gas spent, spawn a random spellcaster at your base. The spellcasters automatically attack the enemy and use their abilities.
Development notes: each of the units from spellcasters boon, but also could spawn high templar variants, brood queen, and medics. Use our standard AI for attacking the enemy while using abilities.

Name: Spawn [amount] [unit]
Effect Description: Spawn [amount] [unit] at target location that automatically attacks the enemy.
Development notes: Choose a random unit and spawn an amount equal to 2000 divided by their added mineral and gas cost. Replace the title and description with the actual amount and unit name.

Name: Spear of Adun Recharge
Effect Description: Set the Spear of Adun's energy to maximum.
Development notes: only appears if at least 2 Spear of Adun abilities are unlocked.

Name: Second Kerrigan
Effect Description: Spawn a second kerrigan that does not respawn on death
Development notes: only appears if you have kerrigan unlocked

Name: Mercenary Favor
Effect Description: Instantly call down all units unlocked in the predator nest and merc compound for free regardless of cooldown and charges
Development notes: does not use charges and does not reset cooldown. Only available if you have at least 3 total mercs available in merc compound or predator nest.

Name: Guardian Matrix
Effect Description: Target unit gains 2000 shields until the shields are completely depleted
Development notes: once their shields = 0, remove the shield entirely

Name: Corruption Spores
Effect Description: Target unit or structure takes double damage until death
